name: Copper mine
note: Native copper broken out of the rock, green with verdigris until it is scoured. Wants a deposit of copper: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Iron mine
note: Ironstone broken from the rock, red and heavy and everywhere, if the fuel holds out. Wants a deposit of iron: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Tin mine
note: Cassiterite broken from veined rock: dark, heavy crystals rare enough to have built trade empires. Wants a deposit of tin: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Lead mine
note: Galena broken from the rock, usually carrying a little silver besides. Wants a deposit of lead: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Calamine mine
note: Calamine broken from the rock: unremarkable ore whose metal only shows itself in the furnace, as brass. Wants a deposit of zinc: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Silver mine
note: Native silver broken from the rock, grown in wires and ferns, tarnishing black. Wants a deposit of silver: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Gold panning
note: Nuggets panned a few at a time from river gravel. Wants a deposit of gold: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Cinnabar mine
note: Heavy vermilion stone broken from the rock; heat turns its red to running silver elsewhere in the shop. Wants a deposit of cinnabar: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Rock-salt mine
note: Cut in blocks from a seam of salt in the rock, grey or pink. Wants a deposit of rock salt: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Sulfur gathering
note: Yellow crystals picked where the ground steams at a hot spring. Wants a deposit of sulfur: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Vitriol gathering
note: Blue crystals picked where water has wept them from a copper-bearing rock. Wants a deposit of blue vitriol: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Realgar mine
note: Red realgar and yellow orpiment broken from the same rock. Wants a deposit of arsenic ore: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Stibnite mine
note: Bundles of grey metallic blades broken from the rock; ground fine, it has lined eyes for four thousand years. Wants a deposit of antimony: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Bismuth mine
note: Pink-tinged ore broken from the rock, long mistaken for tin or lead. Wants a deposit of bismuth: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Alum mine
note: A pale rock broken from the seam, worthless until it is roasted and leached. Wants a deposit of alum stone: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Sal-ammoniac gathering
note: A crust scraped from where a vent or a burning coal seam breathes. Wants a deposit of sal ammoniac: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Limestone quarry
note: Old seabed broken from the rock in blocks; burnt, it becomes the tree's most useful white powder. Wants a deposit of limestone: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Cobalt mine
note: The kobold ore broken from the rock, pink-blooming and stubborn to smelt. Wants a deposit of cobalt: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Tincal gathering
note: Raw borax scraped from the stony margin of a lake no river leaves. Wants a deposit of tincal: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Natron gathering
note: A crust gathered from a dry salt lake's stony margin. Wants a deposit of natron: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Coal mine
note: Broken from a seam in the rock: hotter than wood, dirtier than charcoal. Wants a deposit of coal: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Marcasite mine
note: Broken from the rock; left in the open it weathers to green vitriol. Wants a deposit of marcasite: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Lodestone mine
note: A natural magnet broken from the rock, the stone that lets a ship find its way over open aether. Wants a deposit of lodestone: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Magnesia mine
note: Broken from the rock: the glassmaker's soap, which takes the green out of glass. Wants a deposit of magnesia nigra: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Soil digging
note: Dug wherever the ground allows: whichever of the seventeen soils is underfoot decides what a golem built from it is good at.

name: Kaolin pit
note: Dug from crumbled granite, white as the china it will become.

name: Gypsum quarry
note: Soft rock dug easily, scratched with a fingernail; gently burnt it becomes plaster.

name: Bitumen seep
note: Gathered where it seeps black and sticky out of dry, cracked ground.

name: Lapis mine
note: Cut from a single deep-blue vein flecked with fool's gold. Wants a deposit of lapis lazuli: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Jade picking
note: Picked as water-worn boulders from a riverbed running off stony ground. Wants a deposit of jade: deposits are not in the generator yet.

name: Amber picking
note: Picked out of the scree where old strata crumble at a cliff's foot, warm and light in the hand.

name: Obsidian quarry
note: Broken from black volcanic glass, an edge sharper than steel and just as quick to shatter.

name: Rock-crystal mine
note: Broken out of quartz-veined rock, clear as the ice the ancients took it for.

name: Grain farming
note: Sown and reaped on good wet ground: wheat, spelt, rye, barley, oats or millet, as the climate allows.

name: Rice farming
note: Grown standing in water on waterlogged ground: the wet-field staple.

name: Maize farming
note: Grown on lush warm ground, away from the water it does not want standing.

name: Vine growing
note: Vines trained on thin, dry, well-drained ground.

name: Olive growing
note: Slow trees on hot, stony, dry ground; they outlive the farmer who plants them.

name: Flax growing
note: Grown on good wet ground for its fibre and its oil seed both.

name: Hemp growing
note: Grown coarse and tall on good wet ground: the ship's crop.

name: Cotton growing
note: Grown on lush warm ground for the boll's soft fibre.

name: Cane growing
note: Grown hungry for heat and water on wet ground beside a river.

name: Tea growing
note: An evergreen bush grown in terraces on a scarp's good wet ground.

name: Cacao growing
note: Pods grown in the shade of taller trees, on lush warm ground.

name: Coffee growing
note: Red cherries grown on hot, well-balanced ground.

name: Poppy growing
note: Scored green pods grown on plain, balanced farmland.

name: Agave growing
note: A desert rosette grown on hot, dry, stony ground, taking a decade to mature.

name: Madder growing
note: A scrambling weed grown for its red roots, on plain farmland.

name: Indigo growing
note: A shrub grown on lush warm ground; the blue is a foul business for later, not for the field.

name: Weld growing
note: A roadside weed that asks nothing of thin, dry ground and gives the clearest yellow for it.

name: Bamboo growing
note: A grass that grows a foot a day on wet ground beside a river.

name: Coconut growing
note: Palms grown at the Domain's hot rim, aether beside them where a coastline would be.

name: Areca growing
note: A palm grown on lush warm ground for the nut at its heart.

name: Betel growing
note: A vine grown up the areca palm in the same lush warm grove.

name: Palm growing
note: Oil palms grown on lush warm ground, their fruit pressed red.

name: Kola growing
note: A forest tree grown on lush warm ground for its bitter, stimulating nut.

name: Mulberry growing
note: Grown on good wet ground for its leaves alone: no mulberry, no silk.

name: Herb growing
note: The physic garden and the brewer's basket, grown on good ground out of the wind.

name: Spice growing
note: Vines, buds, bark and pods grown on lush warm ground, light and dry and wildly overpriced once picked.

name: Gall gathering
note: Picked off the oak where a wasp has made it grow a lump packed with tannin.

name: Bark stripping
note: Stripped and ground from oak on good wet ground, for the hide that soaks in it a year.

name: Resin tapping
note: Tapped from living pines on thin, dry ground.

name: Kelp gathering
note: Gathered off the lakeshore and burnt there for its ash.

name: Lacquer tapping
note: Milky sap tapped from the lacquer tree, on lush warm ground.

name: Gum tapping
note: Hardened tears picked off the acacia, on hot, dry ground.

name: Dammar tapping
note: Clear resin tapped from rainforest trees, on lush warm ground.

name: Camphor distilling
note: Chipped and distilled from the wood of a giant tree, on lush warm ground.

name: Benzoin tapping
note: A sweet gum cut from forest trees, on lush warm ground.

name: Frankincense tapping
note: Tears cut from thorny trees on hot, dry ground; temples burn them by the ton.

name: Timber felling
note: Felled in the forest on good wet ground: fuel, ash, planks and charcoal all start here.

name: Dyewood felling
note: Felled on lush warm ground for a heartwood that bleeds red.

name: Acacia felling
note: Acacia felled on hot, dry ground and its heartwood boiled down on the spot.

name: Flock shearing
note: Sheared yearly off a flock at pasture on the rough grazing: a renewable mine.

name: Dairy herd
note: A dairy herd at pasture: milk for the pail, dung and urine along for free.

name: Herd culling
note: Culling the herd: hides and tallow to show for it, with bone, horn and ox blood besides.

name: Beekeeping
note: Hives kept out of the wind at the edge of good farmland, filled from whatever blooms nearby.

name: Cochineal farming
note: Scale insects farmed on cactus pads in dry country.

name: Poultry keeping
note: Hens kept in the yard of any farm on good ground.

name: Fish farming
note: Netted and trapped in the shallows, where the lake bed is close under the water.

name: Goose plucking
note: Flight feathers plucked from geese kept on any good farm.

name: Fur trapping
note: Trapped along a cold riverbank, beaver above all for its pelt.

name: Lac gathering
note: Scraped off twigs where scale insects have crusted them with resin, in the lush hot forest.

name: Shell gathering
note: Picked off the lakeshore after the water has done the work of sorting them by size.

name: Manure gathering
note: Mucked out of any stable or pasture, kept apart for the nitre bed and the alchemist's underrated jar: nobody keeps a herd for this, but the yard gives it up regardless.

name: Knacker's yard
note: Fallen and spent stock rendered down for what the butcher's culling does not already give: bone for the ash pit, horn for the lantern-maker, blood for the sugar house.

name: Essence draw
note: Drawn at the Domain's rim, where aether runs closest. Every magistery and both great assemblies draw on it.
uncertain: Essence's source is one of the open design questions (CLAUDE.md): rim is a guess at where aether sits closest to a Domain, not a ruling on how Essence is actually gathered.
